data.title: Refusal of exemption for boat jetty (Ablehnung Befreiung Bootssteg)
data.summary: The Kreis Nordmuster nature conservation department rejected your application of 12 June 2025 for an exemption to build a 14 m wooden jetty on your property at Deichstraße 44. The letter is dated 1 September 2025 and explains how to file an objection.
data.explanation: The authority refused the exemption (Befreiung) from the landscape protection ordinance for your jetty. It says the shore is a breeding and resting area for protected birds and that the legal conditions for an exemption are not met. You may accept the decision or challenge it by filing an objection (Widerspruch). The app shows until when you can file it. The objection must be in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or recorded in person at the Kreis office. No payment is requested. If you want to object, consider getting advice from a lawyer.

items.title: Decide on objection (Widerspruch)

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe

items.action: If you want to challenge the refusal, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or in person for recording at the Kreis Nordmuster office.
items.consequence: After the deadline the refusal becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
